title: chat-server: Space/set accepts identical server-set values
description: Found by batch 43 (JMAP-t8ej.13 agent). RFC 8620 §5.3: a server-set property in an update is not an error when its value is identical to the current one. Space/set update calls reject_read_only_patch with current=None (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/space.rs ~L1271), so it rejects a server-set key (roles, members, categories, uncategorizedChannelIds) even when the sent value equals the stored one. Fix: pass the stored Space so identical values pass, as other handlers do. Test: update sending the stored roles value unchanged -> updated (oracle RFC 8620 §5.3 text); a different value -> invalidProperties (existing test). Check other chat handlers for the same current=None pattern and list them.
close_reason: Batch 44 (a22b574a, b91e9111, a15f26be), reviewed, local CI green 6772
